## Description

Brief summary of changes proposed in this pull request.

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring with no behavioral change
- [ ] `style`: Design system / UI styling adjustment
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `test`: Test suite additions

## Quality & Verification Checklist

- [ ] All 281 backend unit/integration tests pass (`python -m pytest tests/`).
- [ ] Frontend builds cleanly with zero errors/warnings (`npm run build`).
- [ ] Complies with Swiss typography / anti-slop guidelines (no decorative gradients or ungrounded mock figures).
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets or credentials committed.
